measure.th: นอกขอบของย่านนั้น และห่างจากเส้นขอบไม่เกินระยะที่บอก อีกฝั่งแม่น้ำวัดผ่านทางข้าม · ค่า 800 ม. รวมค่า 400 ม. · รายการเดียวกันอยู่รอบหลายย่านได้ จึงห้ามบวกข้ามย่าน
measure.en: outside the neighbourhood's outline and no farther than the distance from its edge, across a river through the crossings · the 800 m figure holds the 400 m one · one record can be around several neighbourhoods, so figures are never added across neighbourhoods
measure.projection: azimuthal equidistant, centred on the neighbourhood's reference point
notTheSameAs: the registry's lodging screen: walking distance along the path network from its own start points (DATA_METHOD.md §2a)
Yolk MCP: a straight radius from the neighbourhood's reference point

outlines.note: the outline the map draws: the delivered outline simplified at 1.5 m with shared edges kept; the ring of the map is drawn from it

inside.note: a record the data build counted inside an outline is never around it

referenceSet.rule: the 395 outlined neighbourhoods of release 0.4.0, in the order of data/neighborhoods.json, codes joined by a line feed; it stays until a release names the one it replaces, and a neighbourhood added later (0.5.0: the commercial screen, rows[].kind screen) is ranked against it without joining it (D-8)

lowLocated.rule: a dataset with points for under 90% of its records is starred and has no rank or level in «รอบย่านนี้» (D-4)

glance.levelRule: level = min(5, floor(p / 20) + 1) for a value above 0, 0 for a measured zero (montri-th/shoppingcenter js/venue-locale.js#levelOf); p = 100 × (below + ½ equal) / n among the neighbourhoods of the reference set with a value

venues.set: countable · status supply · group mall, community or outlet · located (js/venue-locale.js inLocaleSet)
venues.rule: inside: the build counted it inside the outline (data/records), or — for a centre the pinned Shopping Center file has no point for (notInPinnedFile) — the drawn outline covers its point; near: outside, within 800 m of the edge, straight line (a centre of the pinned file the build did not count inside is near, at its distance, even under 1 m); joined by venue id, never by name

acrossTheDrawnLine.note: the drawn outline is the delivered one simplified at 1.5 m: a record this close to it can fall on the other side; membership follows the data build (a record it did not count inside is around, at 0 m), distance follows the drawn outline

parks.note: per neighbourhood, up to four parks whose 1-rai squares are counted inside or within 800 m of the edge (the same rule as `a`): [park index, squares inside, squares within 800 m]; a park is named, never added to another neighbourhood

rings.note: display only: the line the map draws, the outline grown by the distance and simplified at 2 m, so it can sit a few metres off the exact distance; every count above is measured on the outline itself

rule.th: ฝั่งเดียวกับย่านวัดเส้นตรงจากขอบย่าน อีกฝั่งแม่น้ำวัดระยะผ่านทางข้ามที่ใกล้ที่สุด (ขอบย่าน → ทางข้าม → จุด แต่ละช่วงเป็นเส้นตรง) ทางข้ามคือสะพานและอุโมงค์ถนนทุกระดับ สะพานคนเดิน รถไฟฟ้า และเรือข้ามฟาก ไม่ใช่เวลาเดินหรือขับรถ
rule.en: on the neighbourhood’s bank the straight line from its edge; across a river the distance through the nearest crossing (edge → crossing → place, each leg a straight line); crossings are road bridges and tunnels of every class, footbridges, metro lines and cross-river ferries; not walking or driving time

crossing.method: DATA_METHOD.md#river-crossings (the Shopping Center page’s D70, read from montri-th/shoppingcenter DATA_METHOD.md §32)
crossing.owner: 2026-11-27 06:51, VERBATIM: “ระยะ 400/800 ม. จะคิดเรื่องสิ่งกีดขวางด้วยไหม / คิดด้วย” (D-13)

patch.why: their registry exports gained located points (cinema 0 → 4, nail 49 → 51); every other figure is the build of 0.8.2 (its OpenStreetMap inputs, parks, places of worship and the rivers cache, are outside this build)

sameFigures.read: the new exports, straight line, against the figures of 0.8.2

patch.riverCheck: no figure that changes counts a point in a cell across a barrier river on the residents map (data/people map.x.k); the five points in such cells (nail, ตลาดน้อย–สี่พระยา and บางรัก–สะพานตากสิน) were counted by the river rule of 0.8.2 too and their figures do not change
